decisions.reason: Because it builds directly on the firm's established spraying competence and the firm likely has enough slack in a growing industry to tolerate an uncertain niche launch, management would keep it unless early sales fall clearly below aspiration levels.

As a low-pressure injection pump close to the core offer, it is the kind of incremental product a medium-sized German machinery firm would usually retain while learning from the market, since expected performance should be near aspiration.

A product line with several models indicates committed resource allocation and broad applicability within the existing business, so behavioral-theory logic points to keeping it while exploiting search and adaptation around customer needs.

Although somewhat more adjacent and market acceptance may be less certain, it fits the firm's move toward more future-oriented and interoperable solutions, so management would likely keep it for now unless results soon miss aspirations by a wide margin.
